How much does it cost to run a washer dryer?

A typical washer dryer uses about 5 kWh per cycle (3–7 kWh depending on the model and programme). That's about £1.32 a cycle, or £205 a year at 3 cycles a week, at the current price cap rate.

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Wash at 30°C and run full loads.
  • Spin at the highest speed the fabric allows before drying.
  • Dry outside or on an airer when you can; heat is the expensive part.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a washer dryer per year?

About £205 a year, based on 3 cycles a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my washer dryer's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
